content.title: What happened to Ryan in The Boys?
content.text: Here's what happened to Homelander's son in The Boys season 4 and what we know so far about season 5*Warning - this article contains minor spoilers for The Boys season 5.*One character has been conspicuously missing from The Boys season 5 so far. The Prime Video parody series, which comes from Supernatural creator Eric Kripke, has already broadcast its first two episodes.Fans of the superhero show have now discovered what became of Hughie (Jack Quaid), Butcher (Karl Urban), Starlight (Erin Moriarty) and the rest of the boys following Homelander (Antony Starr) and Sister Sage's (Susan Heyward) rise to power at the conclusion of season 4.However, Ryan (Cameron Crovetti) is yet to make an appearance. Before delving into what we know so far about Ryan's whereabouts this season, let's cast our minds back to the previous season.What happened to Ryan in The Boys season 4?Season 4 saw Ryan thrust into the limelight, as he was taken under the wing of his deeply disturbed father Homelander, residing with him in Vought Tower. However, matters took a turn for the worse when Homelander stumbled upon a photograph of Ryan with his late mother Becca, Billy Butcher and their dog Terror, which sent the Seven leader into a fit of rage, reports the Mirror.Ryan departed from Homelander to visit Butcher and CIA Deputy Director Grace Mallory at a safe house. The pair concurred that Ryan could be utilised as a weapon to bring down Homelander, but held vastly differing views on how to win him over.While Butcher favoured a gradual approach, Mallory made the grave error of confronting Ryan with the harrowing truths surrounding his parentage.This includes the revelation that his father had raped his mother. In a fit of rage, Ryan murdered Mallory and fled the CIA facility, disappearing entirely for the remainder of season 4.Where is Ryan in season 5 of The Boys?Ryan is absent from the opening two episodes of The Boys season 5, though previous trailers suggest he remains very much alive. During an exchange between Homelander and Sister Sage, it emerges that rumours are circulating that Homelander murdered his own son.We also know that Vought's cover story of Ryan attending a Norwegian boarding school is holding firm, at least for the time being. In reality, Ryan is most likely still on the run given the circumstances surrounding the conclusion of his storyline in season 4. Similar articles to thisPowered By While it remains possible that Homelander could be keeping him captive, it seems highly unlikely that his father could restrain him for such an extended period, given the sheer scale of his powers.There is little doubt that Ryan will re-emerge later in the season, with many fans hopeful that he will assist the boys in their bid to bring down Homelander, now that he is fully aware of his father's sinister actions.The Boys episodes 1 and 2 are available to stream now on Prime Video. Subsequent season 5 episodes will air weekly on Wednesdays.
